implementation_policy: One frictional IPC scene in libuipc 0.0.28 (CUDA): a fixed z=0 floor, a fixed 105 x 120 x 790 mm table-leg cuboid, one or two affine-body wooden blocks and a completely unrestrained 160 x 150 x 120 mm sponge meshed as 36,288 Stable Neo-Hookean tetrahedra (E=320 kPa, nu=0.30, 48 kg/m3). The 2 kg block starts 1.16 m from the sponge at 2.8 m/s and decelerates on a sealed oak floor (mu=0.20) before striking the sponge, which slides across an 8 mm gap into the leg; nothing is keyframed. dt=1/1200 s (1/2400 s and 600 Newton iterations for fast_block and soft_010); states are saved at 240 Hz over 0-4.000 s and every case is solved twice to check repeatability. Blender 4.3.2 Cycles replays the cache (appearance/render.py: blocks keyed from the ABD transforms, the sponge as one shape key per FEM state; appearance/room.py: dining-room corner from Poly Haven CC0 scans, window sun and sky, fixed 45 mm camera 0.42 m above the floor), 256 samples, OIDN, 1/96 s motion blur; the video takes every 10th native state (t_i=i/24 s, i=0..95) at 1280x720 / 24 FPS / 96 frames. Five edits change one parameter or object each (speed x1.5, mass x10, sponge E x0.1, delete the sponge, add a 1.25 kg block at the midpoint of the block-to-sponge line) and are audited by the shared edit DSL. tools/export_ground_truth.py writes per-frame ground truth from each cache and the camera of the case's scene.blend; tools/publish_suite.py encodes, compares the two solves and builds a suite in the current PCVE formats; --stage prompts / --export-prompts write the builder catalog prompts into the published suite.
